# Drag Inset El Dialog Full
v-dialogDrag directive wrote inset:0 to .el-dialog causing el-dialog__wrapper to fill and popup blank in zhi2-web-admin of Suzhou real estate monitoring V3.

## Problem
- v-dialogDrag in src/directives/dialog/drag.js set inset:0 on mount, stretching el-dialog__wrapper and leaving popup blank

## Fix
- Rewrote drag.js to use top:15vh + left:50% + translateX(-50%) for centering
- Added :draggable="false" to zs-select-dialog and zs-select-dialog-func to prevent directive altering size

# Branch Status Dict Mismatch
Branch_record_state dictionary conflicted with bizState interface code causing misdisplay of "已注销" in Suzhou real estate monitoring V3.

## Problem
- branch_record_state dict value 2 means 已注销, but interface bizState value 2 means 已备案
- Directly querying table caused list to misdisplay "已注销"

## Fix
- branchStatus.js maps via cancelStatus and bizState dictionary code
- Added e2e/institution/agency-branch-status.spec.js for validation

# Migration Table Save Perm Key
Migration tables in zhi2-web-admin caused save errors and permission primary key misalignment in Suzhou real estate monitoring V3.

## Problem
- PlanDetailsTable.vue called undefined save via saveButton causing save error
- contractTable.vue row-key and primaryKey used personId mismatching multi-select delete

## Fix
- PlanDetailsTable.vue uses viewButton/editButton/deleteButton, permission capital:plan:add/remove
- PeasantAccountTable.vue permission synced to capital:jddetail:add/remove
- contractTable.vue row-key/primaryKey changed to specialDetailId
